title: A/R Detail: the Customer menu ticks several customers and the chip counts them
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customers {Customer-A} and {Customer-B} have open invoices on today's date; {Customer-B}'s name is longer than the chip can show.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-28 Short and {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-28 Northern Alberta Heavy Equipment and Trailer Repair.
  • Starting screen: A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the Customer chip and read the menu from top to bottom.
  2. Type part of {Customer-B}'s name in the search box.
  3. Tick {Customer-B}.
  4. Search for {Customer-A}.
  5. Tick {Customer-A}.
  6. Expand every group.
  7. In the Customer filter, untick both customers.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens with a search box, an "All customers" row, the line "All customers are included. Pick one or more to narrow." and the list of customers.
  • Step 2: {Customer-B} shows in the list.
  • Step 3: {Customer-B} is ticked, and the chip reads "Customer: " and {Customer-B}'s name, shortened with "..." because it is long.
  • Step 4: {Customer-A} shows in the list.
  • Step 5: {Customer-A} is ticked as well, and the chip reads "Customer: 2 customers".
  • Step 6: only the two customers' rows remain.
  • Step 7: no customer is ticked, and the chip reads "Customer: All customers" in the resting (grey) style.

The Customer chip is the native one (as on Sales By Customer): with one name ticked, and for a long name, it reads as that chip does.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R13: “The customer chip (A/R) and vendor chip (A/P) and their open menus are the native ones: Customer exactly as Sales By Customer's Customer filter (person icon), Vendor exactly as Inventory Value's Vendor filter (truck icon, "Search vendors"). The menu has a search box, an "All customers" or "All vendors" row, the native line "All customers are included. Pick one or more to narrow." (or vendors) while none is ticked, and the list; several can be ticked. The chip reads "Customer: All customers" or "Vendor: All vendors" in the resting (grey) style when none is ticked, the name when one is (shortened with "..." when long), and "Customer: N customers" or "Vendor: N vendors" when N are. The ticked customers or vendors narrow every row, group, total, page, sort and export; the Location list does not change (S5-R3).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p7-four-chips-on-every-report.png: figure "Four chips on every report" (This build (after)), board "7. Filters and call list"
  • ar-ap-p7-the-native-vendor-menu.png: figure "The native Vendor menu" (New in this build), board "7. Filters and call list"
  • ar-ap-p7-two-customers-ticked.png: figure "Two customers ticked" (New in this build), board "7. Filters and call list"

The design's own words:

  • "As of, Customer (Vendor on A/P), Past due, Location. "Customer: All customers" and "Past due: Any" rest grey, Past due with the design system’s hourglass icon. S5-R1, S5-R13, S5-R15." (caption of "Four chips on every report")
  • "Vendor chip with the truck icon, as on Inventory Value. Its menu: a search box, "All vendors" ticked, "All vendors are included. Pick one or more to narrow.", then the vendors. S5-R13, S5-R14." (caption of "The native Vendor menu")
  • "Customer menu with 10 Trucking and 4 Star Truck Repair ticked ("2 selected", shown as tags in the search box): the chip reads "Customer: 2 customers", and rows and Totals narrow to them (4 Star Truck Repair has nothing open). S5-R13, S5-R14, S5-R19." (caption of "Two customers ticked")

Design note (DR-03): the design shows with one name ticked the chip keeps its prefix: "Location: Staging Lethbri...", "Customer: 10 Trucking", "Customer: Andrews' Truck ...". Closed without a question: No conflict: PRD S5-R6 / S5-R13 say the chip shows "the name" and the chips are "exactly as on Sales By Customer"; the design shows how (prefix kept, shortened with "..."). Cases now say what the picture shows.
